NAME AND ADDRESS Section 2. DEFINATIONS Section 3. OBJECTIVES Section 4. FUNDS Section 5. MEMBERSHIP Section 6. The liability of a member shall be limited to Section 7. A share certificate shall be issued every time, when a share is subscribed by a member Section 8. The properties and funds of the Federation shall be invested in accordance with the Act and Rules of the State. Section 9. No member once affiliated shall seek disaffiliation without the permission of the Registrar, unless it is dissolved Section 10. Subject to the provisions of the State Co-operative Societies Act, any member may be expelled by a special resolution passed at the General Body Meeting for any of the following reasons Section 11. The member may transfer the share (s) after holding for at least one year to another member with the approval of the Board of Directors of the Federation. No transfer shall be considered complete, until the name of the transferee has been entered into the share transfer Register and a fee of Rs. 1.00 per share has been paid Section 12. CESSATION OF MEMBERSHIP Section 13. OBLIGATIONS OF MEMBERS Section 14. ORGANIZATION AND MANAGEMENT Section 15. GENERAL MEETING Section 16. ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING Section 17. VOTING RIGHTS Section 18. Special General Meeting of the Federation shall be called with 15 days notice, stating the date, time and Place at which and the purpose for which such meeting will be held Section 19. Decision shall be taken by majority of votes. In the case of equality of votes, the Chairman shall have a casting vote in addition to the votes to which he may be entitled to as a member. Section 20. BOARD OF DIRECTORS Section 21. BOARD OF DIRECTORS Section 22. No member shall be allowed to participate or vote on the proceedings of any matter in which he has personal or any other interests. Section 23. No member shall be allowed to participate or vote on the proceedings of any matter in which he has personal or any other interests. Section 24. The Board may meet as often as it considers necessary but it shall meet once in every three months. Section 25. The Chairman of the Union which fails to fulfill the obligations as laid down in the bye-laws, shall cease to continue as a member of the Board. Section 26. POWER, RESPONSIBILITIES AND FUNCTION OF THE BOARD: Section 27. The Board shall be competent to frame subsidiary rules consistent with the provisions of the Act. Rules and Bye-laws for the proper conduct of the business of the Federation. These rules shall be implemented after the approval of the Registrar. Section 28. The Board shall have powers to issue a common seal for the business of the Federation and it shall not be used except by the authority for the Board or the Managing Director. Every deed or document to which the seal is affixed, shall be countersigned by the Managing Director and/or the Chairman as may be decided by the Board. Section 29. MANAGING DIRECTOR Section 30. PROGRAMMING COMMITTEE Section 31. FUNCTIONS OF THE PROGRAMMING COMMITTEE : Section 32. In case of urgency, when a particular decision can not wait till the Board meets, the decision may be carried out by a circular resolution amongst all its members and any resolution so approved by all the members duly signed shall be considered as effective and binding, as if such resolution had been passed at a meeting of the Board. Section 33. DISTRIBUTION OF NET PROFIT Section 34. RESERVE FUND Section 35. ACCOUNTS AND RECORDS Section 36. In case of absence of provisions or inconsistency or repugnancy in the Bye-Laws of the member Unions the Bye-laws of the Federation shall prevail subject to the provisions of the Act and Rules.
